note: Test 1 supplies independent regions and budgets as an experimental aid; it is not learned decomposition. Test 2 uses an engineered flood-fill detector next to each placement, billed per free cell visited; it is not autonomous abstraction. Local entries match on identical translation-normalised geometry with the multiset available; no transformations, hierarchy, or learned gate. Memories are frozen before evaluation; store-phase acquisition is reported separately. Constructed opportunities (Test 1) are never pooled with naturally encountered ones (Test 2).
